correctness.rationale: For any target \(z\) in the unit ball, \(c_0\)-decay supplies three coordinates of norm at most \(1/3\). Replacing one selected coordinate by a fixed Delta-point \(d\) and the other two copies by \(q=(3z-d)/2\) keeps every constructed vector in the unit sphere because \(\|q\|\le1\). Each constructed vector has a coordinate equal to \(d\), so the checked coordinate-lifting theorem makes it a Delta-point. The coordinatewise average is exactly \(z\). Boundary cases are included and no experiment substitutes for proof.
